outcome: duration time of first stage of labor
duration time of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 120 term singleton, nulliparous pregnant women with cephalic presentation who had spontaneous labor and presented to the labor room between June 1st and October 31st, 2013.
finding: Early amniotomy did not significantly differ from late amniotomy in the duration of the first stage of labor but was associated with a statistically significant higher cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: Early amniotomy, performed when patients entered the active phase of labor, did not shorten the duration of the first stage of labor and was associated with a significantly higher cesarean section rate compared to a strategy of leaving membranes intact or reserving amniotomy for specific indications.
